title: Deployed Windows Game stuck on "Now Loading" upon launch

posts.author: LuckyGrass
posts.body:
Preface: I'm new to RPG Maker MV and this is my first game (and my first forum post) so I might be a bit slow and need more detailed explanation, sorry for that.
As the title said, I recently finished my game, deployed it for the Windows platform + exclude unused files and sent it to some beta players. One of them (+myself) uses MacOS and played it using
this method here
and the game ran perfectly. The others use Windows and when they open the "Game.exe" file it always shows the black "Now Loading..." screen.
Edit: The game also runs normally during playtest.
Edit2: I tried copying the game to a new project but the same thing still happened.
I have checked the font folder and replace it with one from a brand new project. I have tried turning off some plugins but the issue remains. Here are my plugins:
I have the Steam copy of RPG Maker MV and use it on Macbook. Please tell me if I can provide any more information, thanks a lot in advance.

posts.author: fonewearl
posts.body:
now loading for me has always been trying to load a save after changes have been made or some other kind of file error I think.
make a new project and deploy it to test to make sure it's not the editor itself.
you kind of have to go into the game files and see if anything is out of place so you should probably take the new project and compare each folder to yours to see if anything looks odd.
there was this I saw:
https://forums.rpgmakerweb.com/index.php?threads/now-loading-stuck.120549/
which said like the project folder cannot have spaced, or perhaps you need to uninstall and reinstall rpg maker to fix it
but yeah usually "now loading" is some kind of file error, either something is missing, placed wrong, named wrong or a plugin is breaking things

What I did was copying the data folder + the plugin.js file to a new project, then add individually each new asset (audio, tileset, character sprites) to said project.
The old and the new project both run fine during playtest so I don't think it is a problem with the editor nor the path (I also checked that just in case, and I made sure there is no spaces in the name. I tried putting the new project in a new folder to see if that fixes anything but it didn't).
My main issue is that when deployed into a package, Windows users get stuck on the now loading screen. If I runs a http-server using Terminal on Mac then it runs fine again.

posts.author: LuckyGrass

Good news! I copied the data folder and other asset folders (audio, img) to a fresh project, then I installed each plugin one by one. I haven't touched the para of them yet so Im not sure if changing them will mess the game again, but it is now running with this plugin set up:
I will try changing the para and report on that later.
Update: I don't want to double post so I will update here. The game runs fine now, even after I adjust the plugins para! I basically made a fresh project on my Windows PC and transfer data over that fresh project, then install & adjust plugins one by one again. I still can't pinpoint the issue, but it's either one of the deleted plugins messed the font up or something was wrong with the Mac version, so if any of you run into the same problem, consider that.
Thanks a lot to all that helps, especially
@utunnels
